content.english: For your love, I drink my goblet –
Greetings to you, greetings, O Seventh Day!
The six days of work are like slaves to you,
If I work on them, I am full of sleeplessness.
In my eyes, they are all like just a few days,
Out of my love for you, O my king and my shepherd!

content.hebrew: שָׁלוֹם שָׁלוֹם לְךָ שָׁלוֹם : יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי:
content.transliteration: Shalom Shalom lecha shalom : yom hashevi‘i.
content.english: Greetings / Greeting to you, greetings, O Seventh Day!
I go out on the Sunday, to do my labor,
To prepare things for the Sabbath day,
For that is where God has placed blessing –
You are my portion, out of all my toil.

content.hebrew: שָׁלוֹם שָׁלוֹם לְךָ שָׁלוֹם : יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי:
content.transliteration: Shalom Shalom lecha shalom : yom hashevi‘i.
content.english: Greetings / Greeting to you, greetings, O Seventh Day!
The light for my holy day is the Torah of my holy one.
The sun and the stars are jealous of my sun!

content.hebrew: מַה לִּי לְיוֹם שֵׁנִי : אוֹ לַשְּׁלִישִׁי:
content.transliteration: Ma li leyom sheni : o lashelishi
content.english: What do I care of the Monday, or of Tuesday;
Let Wednesday conceal its light.

content.hebrew: שָׁלוֹם שָׁלוֹם לְךָ שָׁלוֹם : יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי:
content.transliteration: Shalom Shalom lecha shalom : yom hashevi‘i.
content.english: Greetings / Greeting to you, greetings, O Seventh Day!
I hear a herald of good things, on Thursday,
That the morrow will be the rest for my soul,
That [Friday] morning will be still my servitude, but evening will be my freedom!
In the evening, I will forget all my wanderings!

content.hebrew: שָׁלוֹם שָׁלוֹם לְךָ שָׁלוֹם : יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי:
content.transliteration: Shalom Shalom lecha shalom : yom hashevi‘i.
content.english: Greetings / Greeting to you, greetings, O Seventh Day!
On Friday, I find that my soul is happy,
Since the time of rest is coming near.

content.hebrew: אִם נָע וְנָד אֵלֵךְ : אֶמְצָא רְוָחָה:
content.transliteration: Im na‘ venad elech : emtsa revaḥa
content.english: Though I may wander, I’ll soon find peace,

content.hebrew: כִּי יוֹם מְנוּחָה זֶה : יוֹם שַׁעֲשׁוּעִי:
content.transliteration: Ki yom menuḥa ze : yom sha‘ashu‘i
content.english: For this is my day of rest, my day of delight!

content.hebrew: שָׁלוֹם שָׁלוֹם לְךָ שָׁלוֹם : יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי:
content.transliteration: Shalom Shalom lecha shalom : yom hashevi‘i.
content.english: Greetings / Greeting to you, greetings, O Seventh Day!

content.hebrew: מַה נָּעֲמָה לִי עֵת : בֵּין הַשְּׁמָשׁוֹת:
content.english: You are so pleasing to me, the time of dusk,
When I see a new face, the Sabbath day!
Come with apples, come near with dried figs,
Come near to the table, O my king and shepherd!

content.hebrew: שָׁלוֹם שָׁלוֹם לְךָ שָׁלוֹם : יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי:
content.transliteration: Shalom Shalom lecha shalom : yom hashevi‘i.
content.english: Greetings / Greeting to you, greetings, O Seventh Day!
I sing to you, O Sabbath, a song of friendship,

content.hebrew: גַּם טוֹב לְזַמֵּר בָּךְ : גַּם טוֹב לְהוֹדוֹת:
content.transliteration: Gam tov lezammer bach : gam tov lehodot
content.english: For it is good to sing to you, and good to express thanks
To God, who sanctified the beloved day,
The delight for my soul, the balm for my wound.

content.hebrew: שָׁלוֹם שָׁלוֹם לְךָ שָׁלוֹם : יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי:
content.transliteration: Shalom Shalom lecha shalom : yom hashevi‘i.
content.english: Greetings / Greeting to you, greetings, O Seventh Day!
With you is the light of Torah, and the extra spirit,
With you is extra strength, along with total understanding.
Since you are joy and light for the joy,
Indeed, you are my head’s crown, and my arm’s bracelet.

content.hebrew: שָׁלוֹם שָׁלוֹם לְךָ שָׁלוֹם : יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי:
content.transliteration: Shalom Shalom lecha shalom : yom hashevi‘i.
content.english: Greetings / Greeting to you, greetings, O Seventh Day!
